fact: Thorin used a die roll (a D2) to determine that the party should go left at the first intersection.
source_quote: So I rolled a D2, otherwise known as flip a coin, and it came up one. So I say we go left
subject: route selection

fact: The chosen route led into a 10-foot-high passage with walls that glistened with dark, dripping water.
source_quote: The chosen route led into a 10-foot-high passage whose walls glistened with dark, dripping water
subject: 10-foot-high passage

fact: Thorin initially refused to step into the pool because he feared creatures would emerge.
source_quote: creepy crawlies will come out and get me
subject: Thorin refuses water

fact: Thorin's examination revealed that the water in the pool was rising at an alarming rate.
source_quote: his examination revealed an even greater danger: the water was rising at an alarming rate
subject: Thorin's examination

fact: Daz investigated and confirmed that the entire complex was leaking.
source_quote: Daz investigated further and confirmed that the entire complex was leaking
subject: Daz's investigation

fact: A tremor had cracked an underground reservoir or river into the cave system, causing the temple to fill with water.
source_quote: A tremor had cracked an underground reservoir or river into the cave system, and unless the party found a way out, the temple would eventually fill completely
subject: cause of flooding

fact: Thorin searched for a mechanism to close a door behind them but noticed nothing.
source_quote: Thorin searches for a mechanism that could close a door behind them. He notices nothing
subject: Thorin

fact: Jimjar remarked that the flooding was an appropriate bet involving tears and water.
source_quote: What an appropriate bet. Tears, water
subject: Jimjar

fact: Thorin argued that the square, constructed chamber beyond the pool was more likely to offer an exit than the natural cave passage.
source_quote: Thorin argued that the square, constructed chamber beyond the pool was more likely to offer an exit than the natural cave passage
subject: Thorin

fact: The party rushed forward through the water into the chamber.
source_quote: the party rushed forward
subject: party advances

fact: A gray ooze emerged from the water as Thorin advanced through the chamber.
source_quote: a gray ooze emerged exactly as he had predicted
subject: gray ooze

fact: Thorin noted that his Constitution gave him a reasonable chance if swimming and breath-holding became necessary, so he led.
source_quote: Thorin leads because his Constitution gives him a reasonable chance if swimming and breath-holding become necessary
subject: Thorin

fact: Jimjar admitted he wished he had lost the bet.
source_quote: I really wished I had lost this bet, Thorin
subject: Jimjar

fact: Thorin observed that there was something creepy crawly in the water, as he had predicted.
source_quote: Okay, so not only is the water, but there’s also something creepy crawly in the water, as I predicted
subject: Thorin

fact: The party noted that gray oozes can destroy nonmagical ammunition and progressively damage nonmagical metal weapons and armor.
source_quote: The party remembers that gray oozes can destroy nonmagical ammunition and progressively damage nonmagical metal weapons and armor
subject: ooze corrosion

fact: Dawnbringer is described as a weapon of light, like a lightsaber, and is therefore not vulnerable to the ooze's corrosion because it is not made of metal.
source_quote: Dawnbringer is not made of metal; it is described as a weapon of light, “as a lightsaber,” and therefore is not vulnerable to the ooze’s corrosion
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: The party rejected grappling the ooze because it could ooze through holds.
source_quote: Grappling is rejected because the creature could simply ooze through any hold
subject: tactics rejected

fact: Zalthir destroyed the gray ooze with two powerful unarmed blows.
source_quote: Zalthir stepped forward and destroyed the creature with two powerful unarmed blows before anyone else could act
subject: gray ooze killed

fact: Zalthir struck the ooze for 10 damage, then 12 more.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes for 10 damage, then 12 more, killing the ooze
subject: Zalthir's strikes

fact: The gray ooze is dead, killed by Zalthir.
source_quote: killing the ooze before the rest of the party needs to commit resources
subject: gray ooze

fact: Thorin noted that the encounter added magical armor to his list of desirable equipment.
source_quote: Thorin notes that the encounter has added magical armor to his growing list of desirable equipment
subject: Thorin

fact: Jimjar asked if the party was now committed to a slow death due to drowning.
source_quote: The party presses onward despite Jimjar asking whether they are now committed to “a slow death due to drowning”
subject: Jimjar

fact: Thorin used another die roll to settle the next decision, noting that a result greater than 10 is always the most reckless action.
source_quote: Thorin uses another die roll to settle the decision: “Greater than 10 is always the most reckless action”
subject: next decision
